Hi Diego,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Avalon is interested in moving forward but legal has a few gating questions before procurement can kick off:

1) Could you share Redwood's standard DPA template for our legal team to review?
2) We need a current list of subprocessors (and regions) that will process Avalon data.
3) Does Redwood rely on SCCs or other transfer mechanism for EU->US transfers? If you have a one-pager on data flows (what data is stored vs transient), that would help.

We expect to redline for a narrow data retention clause and a SOC2/attestation reference. If possible, please include whether you support e-sign (DocuSign/Adobe Sign).

Could you send the template and subprocessors CSV today? Procurement timeline is tight.

Thanks,

Date: 2026-05-03T17:25:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Avalon DPA — quick review notes

Diego / Neha — skimmed Avalon's likely redlines (based on prior deals). Quick guidance: 

1) Retention — we should accept a limited retention carve (90/180 days) but tie to product config (customers can set retention in Dedicated/Private); for Hosted propose 180 days default, with option to shorten for enterprise.
2) Subprocessors — provide current list and a 30-day notice for new subprocessors; we refuse a unilateral right for customer to 'approve' every new subprocessor.
3) Transfers — accept SCCs; if they require EU data residency, note that Hosted cannot guarantee without Dedicated/Private subscription; offer a migration path and timeline.
4) Audit/SOC2 — we can provide SOC2 Type II report under NDA; do not accept unlimited audit right or onsite inspections.

I redlined retention language and added a clause about limited audit scope — see attached Avalon_DPA_v3_redlines.docx (I inserted comments where we should negotiate).

I'm available for a 30-min call tomorrow 10:30 PT to triage redlines. If you want, I can join the call with Sara.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>

Hi Sara — thanks for the quick turnaround. Two updates after internal review:

1) We attached a suggested redline (Avalon_DPA_v3_redlines.docx) with comments from our counsel. High-level summary: we accepted a limited retention concession (180 days by default; customer-configurable on Dedicated/Private) and a 30-day notice for new subprocessors. We preserved a carve for SOC2 access via secure sharing under NDA.

2) Subprocessors spreadsheet is attached for your records (hosts, monitoring, vector DB provider). If you need a live inventory, we can provide a filtered CSV for your scope.

3) Transfers: Hosted relies on SCCs + contractual safeguards. If Avalon needs EU residency, we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment and can provide a migration timeline (typically 4–8 weeks for initial setup).

Next steps:
- If Avalon can accept the changes in the attached redline, we will prepare the DocuSign envelope and send for signature; otherwise, please flag any items you want to discuss on a quick call.
